title: White Sulfur Gas
description: Changes the sulfur gas from yellow to white.
body:
Changes the **Sulfur**/**Noxious** gas to a white color to better match the geyser foam and to better assist in building. 

  Should work with any other resource pack that changes the texture as long as this is placed above it in the list.

![Before And After](https://files.catbox.moe/u0242h.png)


**Feel free to use this in modpacks/servers.**
